I found an injured dog in Silchar. I think Silchar is in West Bengal. Can you find veterinary treatment there?

Silchar is in **Cachar district, Assam**—not West Bengal.

Please keep the injured dog away from traffic if it is safe, minimise handling, and use gentle continuous pressure with a clean cloth if there is active external bleeding.

**Government treatment**
- **State Veterinary Hospital, Silchar**  
  **Hospital Road, Ambicapatty / Silchar Town, Cachar, Assam 788005**  
  Published veterinary-officer phone: **73998 25303**. The Assam government’s veterinary records identify this as the State Veterinary Hospital in Silchar, and the district facility listing places Silchar Veterinary Hospital in Silchar Town, Ward 11. ([cvscadmaclab.org.in](https://www.cvscadmaclab.org.in/contact_us/CONNECT-NER%20VETS%20A%20DIRECTORY.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
  *The published number appears to be for the veterinary officer, not confirmed hospital reception—please call to ask whether the doctor can see an injured community dog immediately.*

**Private clinic**
- **New Unique Pets — Dr. Manoranjan Sarkar (BVSc & AH)**  
  Nagnaha Lane, Hospital Road, opposite New Mayur Hotel, near New Oxford School, Ambicapatty, Silchar, Assam 788004  
  **Phone: 081360 79015**  
  The clinic lists general veterinary consultation and diagnostic/laboratory services. ([petcare.ai](https://petcare.ai/vets/dr-manoranjan-sarkar-silchar-a93dd9?utm_source=openai))

**Government option: Veterinary Hospital, Udupi**

**Location:** The same official department listing places it at the mapped Veterinary Hospital Udupi location in Udupi town (coordinates **13.320773, 74.747853**). ([ahvs.kar.nic.in](https://www.ahvs.kar.nic.in/pdfs/others/Udupi_Ahvs.pdf?utm_source=openai))
